data.name: Leashed Soul
data.detailed_description:
Leashed Soul is a casual, family-friendly 3D adventure game of tricky logic puzzles with high quality graphics and effects, and an interesting plot. The quest takes place in a wonderful fantasy world with changing seasons where you have to be smart to save the world.
It all starts like a fairy tale. Beydo, the wooden doll comes to life and escapes from his creator to start on a mission. He advances through 50 exciting levels of tricky logic puzzles to have all the magical seeds so he can plant trees all over the world.
During his emotional journey, Beydo has to tackle obstacles of different difficulty and only you can make him succeed. Join him on his quest to reach all the magical seeds in a maze-like world full of blocks and adventures, and plant trees to make the world a better and greener place. Although the game has handy system of controls, but don’t ever think your quest will be that easy! You have to beat all the levels of the dark and lifeless winter just like those of the hopeful spring.
Have fun with our wooden boy and help him reach his goal: to save the Earth from becoming a bleak place without trees and forests.
Our game was inspired by the most popular puzzle games out there, but we added a unique, loveable story and touch to them.

data.short_description: Use your imagination! How grateful would you be if you got the biggest and best present you could dream of? When Beydo, the wooden doll comes to life he starts on a mission that spans through 50 different levels and different seasons to thank his gift by planting trees and creating life. Embark on an exciting puzzle adventure!

reviews.review:
Leashed Soul is a lighthearted puzzle adventure that combines environmental themes with accessible gameplay in a colorful fantasy setting. Developed by Level One Games and published by LumiNet, the game follows the story of Beydo, a wooden doll who unexpectedly gains life and sets out on a journey to restore balance to a world that has lost much of its natural beauty. Armed with determination and a noble purpose, Beydo travels through a variety of seasonal landscapes in search of magical seeds that can be used to bring trees and life back to the environment.

One of the game's most appealing qualities is its presentation. The world is designed around changing seasons, giving each area a distinct visual identity while reinforcing the theme of renewal and growth. From snowy regions to vibrant spring scenery, every environment contributes to a relaxing atmosphere that encourages exploration. The bright colors, charming art direction, and pleasant visual effects create a welcoming experience that feels suitable for players of all ages. While the graphics are not technically groundbreaking, they effectively support the game's tone and make the adventure enjoyable to look at from beginning to end.

Gameplay focuses on solving puzzles spread across approximately fifty levels. Players must guide Beydo through a series of maze-like environments, overcoming obstacles and finding solutions that allow progression toward each magical seed. The mechanics are easy to understand, making the game approachable for newcomers and casual players. As the adventure progresses, new challenges gradually appear, requiring more careful planning and observation. The controls remain straightforward throughout, allowing players to concentrate on solving puzzles rather than struggling with complicated systems.

The narrative itself is simple but meaningful. Beydo's mission is rooted in gratitude for the life he has been given, and his desire to restore nature provides a positive motivation that carries the game forward. Rather than relying on dramatic twists or heavy storytelling, Leashed Soul emphasizes themes of hope, responsibility, and environmental care. This creates a pleasant emotional backdrop that complements the puzzle-solving gameplay without overwhelming it.

The game's relaxed nature can be both a strength and a weakness depending on the audience. Players looking for a calm and family-friendly experience will likely appreciate the gentle progression and forgiving difficulty. On the other hand, puzzle veterans may find that many challenges can be solved relatively quickly, leaving them wanting more complexity and depth. The game prioritizes accessibility over difficulty, making it more suitable for casual enjoyment than for those seeking intense mental challenges.

Sound design also contributes to the overall experience. The music maintains a soothing tone that matches the peaceful atmosphere, while the audio effects help bring the environments to life without becoming distracting. Together with the visual presentation, the soundtrack reinforces the game's relaxing identity and helps create an experience that is easy to enjoy in shorter play sessions.

Overall, Leashed Soul succeeds as a charming indie puzzle adventure that delivers a positive message through simple yet enjoyable gameplay. Its attractive seasonal environments, approachable puzzle design, and uplifting environmental themes make it a pleasant experience for younger players, casual gamers, and anyone looking for a relaxing journey. While it may not offer the complexity or challenge sought by hardcore puzzle enthusiasts, its sincerity, charm, and accessibility make it a worthwhile adventure that leaves a warm impression long after the final puzzle has been completed.

Rating: 6/10
